approval.meaning: Approval of the action-v1 visual direction across the current Inventory/Store preview set. This does not establish rendered phone or native-runtime acceptance.
coverage: Inventory: Balls grid, selected details, equipped state
Inventory: Explosions, Flyers and Fusion preview/availability pages
Store: Events and Balls offers plus collection spotlight
Store: Explosions and Flyers routes to matching Inventory categories
Shared headers, category navigation, primary actions, close/reopen

supersedes: All earlier stud and theme-proposal concepts are historical, not active targets.

typography.notes: Exact unmodified font files embedded. No synthetic weight/italic. Title outlined, ordinary text unoutlined. Minimum labels 11px, descriptions 13–14px, main titles 29–42px.

composition: Crisp dark frame, graphic crimson-magenta header with diagonal shapes and outlined ghost typography; no studs.
Quiet collection cards: cyan selected border and label, equipped check plus named footer state.
Pale ball showcase, unchanged canonical ball and existing Axe/Blade weapon icons, kit and description, cyan Equip action.
Store: cyan collection feature and four aligned offers using canonical artwork.
850/650/450px container breakpoints: 4→3 collection columns, detail below collection on phones, Store feature above two-column offers. No fixed outer height or internal scrolling.
interactions: Local selection and equip for all 12 balls
Store View Ball and Flyer routing
Optional graphic-intensity and hero-size design controls
v7 state persistence; ignores older stud state
functionalLimits: Events/Balls Store categories retain all four preview offers.
No purchases, rarity, XP, gifting, economy, new kits or fusion mechanic.

validation.limits: Static checks and font metrics only, not rendered or browser interaction validation. Earlier local-preview URL-policy restriction remains; no alternate browser or rendering bypass used.
pending: User acceptance of final native implementation
